metadata.question: Did Arrachart in Madagascar recieve more than 22 inches of rainfall during the month of January 2020?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about rainfall in Arrachart, Madagascar during January 2020. I need to: 1. Use precipitation data - CHIRPS (Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Station data) would be appropriate 2. Define the location for Arrachart, Madagascar (coordinates approximately [-12.349, 49.2915]) 3. Filter for January 2020 (2020-01-01 to 2020-02-01) 4. Sum the precipitation for the month 5. Convert from mm to inches (1 inch = 25.4 mm) 6. Check if the total is > 22 inches For data quality: - Check if collection is empty (C1) - Check if valid pixels exist (C2) - Validate the calculation result (C3) CHIRPS data is in mm, so I need to convert to inches. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const point = ee.Geometry.Point([49.2915, -12.349]); // Arrachart, Madagascar const startDate = '2020-01-01'; const endDate = '2020-02-01'; // 2. Data Acquisition - CHIRPS precipitation data const chirps = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(point); const collectionSize = chirps.size().getInfo(); console.log(`January 2020 images: ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Sum precipitation for the month const monthlyPrecip = chirps.sum(); // Check pixel count const pixelCount = monthlyPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: point, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation').getInfo(); console.log(`Valid pixels: ${pixelCount}`); if (pixelCount === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // 4. Calculation - Get precipitation and convert mm to inches const precipMm = monthlyPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: point, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation').getInfo(); const precipInches = precipMm / 25.4; // Convert mm to inches console.log(`Total rainfall: ${precipInches.toFixed(2)} inches`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (precipInches === null || precipInches === undefined || isNaN(precipInches)) { console.log("C3"); } else if (precipInches > 22) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
